lines: 📡 The next act is still waiting — armor the village (1 of 4 fighters armored); blood your fighters (0 of 2 veterans).
— DAY 110 DAWN — The world wakes. Animals are active.
Overnight, Cottontail Rabbit (cleaned) went bad — beyond saving. You leave it for the flies.
Fresh food keeps days, not weeks. Smoke it over a fire to make it last.
💬 Federica says: "Do you think they're watching right now? The... audience? I try not to think about it."
💬 Sun-young says: "They said you're doing well. It sounded... proud? Can they feel proud?"
"Three losses. The crowd is getting that look. You know the look."
You wake with a start — something is wrong.
📺 Low and slow. The locals have routines. You learn them fast.
📺 MAIN EVENT rules: the arena runs hotter tonight. You start this one already hurt — the galaxy loves an underdog. Especially a bleeding one.
📺 The billing said EXTREME RISK. The System doesn't pull its punches.
📺 You take 18 damage.
📺 You're inside. The locals are close — you can hear them. Your sack is half full. Greed and sense are negotiating.
📺 You grab and RUN. Shouting behind you. Your sack is full and your heart is fuller.
📺 You take 35 damage.
📺 Out. The weigh-in is in front of the cameras. Your sack vs theirs. The locals are watching from the treeline.
📺 You lay it out. The calorie count climbs. The crowd counts with it. You win on density.
📚 Pantry Raid: you know its beats now. The intro will tell you what you've learned.
📺 Hardened Pantry Raid — YOU WIN. The crowd is a weather system.
📈 your showbiz fans +8 — won Hardened Pantry Raid on camera (favor: 48)
📺 The System presses something humming into your hands: Gravity well. Creates a point of intense gravity. Don't drop it.
📺 SYSTEM: "UNIT KNIFE ROLL — the cameras kept finding it. It mattered to you on the floor, and that is... interesting. Meaning is fuel. We are curious what it becomes. (+5 bond on your Knife roll)"
📺 The lights take their cut. Winning marks you. (-5 health.)
📺 You won. Your hands won't stop shaking for a while. (+4 trauma.)
📺 While you fought your fight, they fought theirs.
📺 Sun-young brings in 3.
📺 Sun-young WON. You didn't see it — you had your own arena. The village will tell you about it for weeks.
📺 Prize for Sun-young: the winner's share — alien rations for the pantry. The village eats tonight.
No risky water to boil.
Drank clean water.
📋 Wei — 💧 Fetch water. Wei nods eagerly. They'll report back by next part.

◈ THE TABLE — it is not a table. It's a ring of pale light, and around it, things with too many angles to be faces. Above it all — the audience. Trillions of eyes, and every one of them knows your name. The System speaks, and for once it isn't performing: "HUMANITY PRESENTS ITS CASE."

◈ THE AUDIT — the System reads your run back to you, and the galaxy listens. A lesser seat — regional standing, waves 1–3 faced (8/8/3), 12 contests survived, 4 crises weathered. The table does not rise. It prices.
EVERYONE. SIT. WATCH. The teeth and the weather can WAIT — nothing out there matters until this is done. ...Did I stutter? SIT.
💧 Wei returns with 12L of creek water. Risky until the hearth boils it.
You catch fragments by the fire — Wei telling Taine about you. The story's getting bigger than what happened.
You catch fragments by the fire — Gonzalo telling Sun-young about Federica. The retelling is already better than the event.
Wei sets out to find Iin. "Won't be long."
🌿 Taine returns from foraging the wilds: +512 kcal to the pantry.
🩹 Gonzalo is hurting (29 HP) — You patch them up before they head out. (29 → 54 HP)
Gonzalo sets out to find Iin. "Won't be long."
Federica sets out to find Iin. "Won't be long."
🚶 Carmen is back — found Iin.
Iron cold. Even the ticks are shelved.
— MIDDAY — Honest work hours. Heat builds.
You wait. The light changes. Nothing asks anything of you.
Your pack is full — water is heavy (1L = 1kg). Drink some or drop weight before filling.
No risky water to boil.
Drank clean water.
You catch fragments by the fire — Gonzalo telling Yash about Federica. Someone's added a flourish that wasn't there this morning.
📖 Carmen has their finds spread out on a cloth, re-tying the bundle tighter.
— DUSK — Animals stir again. Shadows lengthen.
Riders from The Red Table: something's at THEIR door now. They can't spare anyone — and they wanted Haven to know first.
You wait. The light changes. Nothing asks anything of you.
Your pack is full — water is heavy (1L = 1kg). Drink some or drop weight before filling.
— NIGHT — Camp. Rest — or risk the dark.
No watches tonight. Everyone sleeps with one ear open and pretends not to.
You wait. The light changes. Nothing asks anything of you.
◈ ABILITY — Dreadfield: The room feels you before you speak. Alien-terror starts at 2.
◈ ABILITY — War-table: You read the table's fear the way you read weather. The Nielsen flinches first — you saw it.
◈ ABILITY — Oathbound: Your terror is pledged as a shield: your own people's horror grows half as fast.
◈ ABILITY — Shieldbearer: Spend terror to calm horror — the shield, not the sword. (Offered in the final beat.)
🔴 LIVE! the terror broadcast: WHAT EATING BUILT
◈ THE FEARED — "Look what eating built." The footage plays unasked — the deer, the fire, the ones who came for you and didn't come back. Nobody at the table is comfortable. That is the point.
The table has read your ledger. The protected outnumber the killed; the food truth was shared. The light road is open.
The deer. The cleanest kill. The table goes very still. Behind you, your own people go still too — a different stillness.
You let them see it. All of it. The table recalculates. The fire back home burns a little lower.
You spend it — the shield, not the sword. The small envoy stares. Your people stand a little straighter. Protective terror: the table writes it down and doesn't understand it, which is the point.
◈ THE FEARED — the last choice is yours, and it's live.
◈ THE FEARED — "Show mercy."

The most frightening thing you ever did. The table doesn't know what to do with mercy from a predator. Neither do you, quite. But the audience weeps, and the galaxy learns that the feared one chose gentleness — and that choice echoes longer than any threat. The terror stays, pledged now: a shield over every village, forever.
◈ Iin Tamba walks out of the light alone, which is how they walked in. The village endures. That was always the story.
◈ THE OVERSIGHT —
You won. Say it plainly: you won. The village endures. The table signed. The galaxy applauds, and the applause is real, and you earned it.
And somewhere out there — past the cameras, past the light — in rows of humming glass, the little ones are still napping.
The System put a pod on the screen, and you let the segment play.
They are still there. Still small. Still waiting for someone to decide they matter more than the moment.

That is what the word means. Not the watching — anyone can watch. The oversight is the looking away. The most terrible thing the System ever did, it did by accident, because it was bored. You did it on purpose, because you were busy.
The village will tell your story for years. It will be a good story. Listen for the part they don't tell.

💛 You hold Contract Quill. Your gifts are not mastered — but they are lived-in, worn smooth by use, and they are with you. The feast was the weapon. (The next feast grants FEASTED until tomorrow's dawn: strikes & abilities uplifted, devotion ×1.5 — richer feasts hit harder.)
